note: Set A correctly extracts the General Sheet Note regarding edge radius and provides accurate dimensions for Beam D5 (Grid 5), whereas Set B confuses beam labels (identifying A4 as Grid 6 and B4 as Near Grid 5) and misses the general note. While both sets contain dimension reading errors and section binding mistakes (e.g., swapping W8X13/W10X13 for Roof/Floor beams near Grid 5/6), Set A maintains better label-to-beam consistency overall.
